switch.name: Nintendo Switch (Eden / Citron on lilspark, Yuzu on Windows)
switch.emulators: Eden v0.2.1 on lilspark (RE5, RE6; NCE: the game's ARM64 code runs natively); Citron NEO on lilspark for RE4 only (adapters.SWITCH_CITRON_TITLES); portable Yuzu on Windows PCs (i9-NUC: the RE6 hot-reload test).
switch.files: LayeredFS overlay builds (gbox/switch_mods.py, docs/switch-mods.md): a build folder holds only the changed RomFS / ExeFS files plus .gbox-mod.json (history, .gbox-backup copies, .gbox-pending edits). It is linked into the emulator's load/<title id>/<build>; every other build of the title goes in [DisabledAddOns]. The base NSP is never copied. Write with switch_mods op=write or file_mod op=build, undo with op=revert. Eden and Citron layer the RomFS once, when the title boots.
switch.ram: Linux (Eden / Citron): /proc/<pid>/mem inside the emulator's HostMemory memfd arena (gbox/eden_memory.py, SwitchLinuxAdapter.read_memory / write_memory). Under NCE a guest address is the host address; read-only guest pages are written through a writable alias of the same memfd. The titles are ASLR: every hook is the main module's base (found by a 64-byte signature) plus an offset, so the RAM maps hold no absolute fields. Windows Yuzu: only through the GDB stub of a private debug=true launch (YuzuAdapter.debugger).

rules: NCE: never rewrite guest code that has already run. Eden / Citron run the game natively and the Spark's cores report CTR_EL0.DIC = 0 (no instruction-cache coherency), so code written from outside the emulator is not seen reliably: RE4's loadout code patch hung every stage load and is off (mercs/titles/re4_switch_mods.py LOADOUT_CODE_PATCH = False, 'refused under NCE'). Data writes are fine; new code only in never-run padding reached through data; ExeFS patches only at boot. (docs/DEEPSEEK-HANDOFF-2026-11-10.md, Lesson 1.)
No save states on Eden / Citron: any swap that reboots the title loses the round; a hot reload needs a round boundary.

pickwhip.how: pick_identify has no RE4/Switch backend (pick_tool LIVE_PLATFORMS has no switch; the picker falls back to a colour region). Ingredients exist: unit pos +0xA4, camera block pG+0xA8 (ProjMat +0x10C), the laser's m_SightEm, tactical-map clicks on Ganados.

gaps: No RAM link from a unit to its drawn pack, BIN or texture, and no hook into the loader that streams em/pl packs: a mesh cannot change mid-round.

NCE rule: Citron runs RE4 natively (NCE) and the Spark's cores have no I-cache coherency (CTR_EL0 DIC=0), so gBox must not rewrite executed guest code (LOADOUT_CODE_PATCH=False after every stage load hung).

Allowed code routes under NCE: data writes, boot-time ExeFS overlays, or code in never-run zero padding via the code segment's backing file reached by data (RE5/RE6 controllers). RE4 has no such native call harness yet.
No-reboot file swap untested on RE4: switch_mods op=hotswap (same length, round boundary) is proven on RE6/Yuzu (i9) only; whether RE4 re-reads em/pl udas at each stage load on Citron is unknown.
Character -> pack table in main not read: Ada (pl0b vs pl0c/pl16), HUNK/Krauser/Wesker are art-inferred; only pl08 = Leon was shown live.
ESL type byte -> Ganado body slot is inferred; no frame shows four different Village donors at once.
Pickwhip: no RE4 Switch entity backend; the camera's in-round projection against unit positions is not verified.
No registered switch_mods character writer for 010099A00BC1E000: characters op=use does not route; builds come from the re4_switch_models / re4_switch_enemies CLIs + switch_mods op=write.
Donor materials are plain: cut-outs need an opacity-map material (byte 14, GX I4) the writer does not write; a material colour tint stops the stage load.
Fitted-cast acceptance (fit v4) is in session notes, not a repo receipt; the four Leon probe overlays never reached an in-round frame.
Ops: Mercenaries needs a save past the Village (auto-loaded at boot); one Switch emulator per PC; Citron only; builds must sit under 270a15eb98dab4d7.
RAM map file is stale: 010099A00BC1E000-ram.json says Eden-only, units_per_m 100 and mercs.ready false, while the driver measures mm on Citron.

The tactical map names each enemy by RAM class (enemy_identity) and a click sends the bot to it; model_swap redraws the player slot from the next fit-passing donor, an enemy class only reverts to native, at the next round.

gaps: No zero-restart archive swap on Eden: switch_mods op=hotswap (same-length, in place) exists but recovery-hotswap-probe-20261109 has no recorded result; Eden packs the layered RomFS once per boot.
No save states on Eden/Citron: every file swap reboots the title and loses the round (the incident report carries a 48 KiB RAM witness instead).
No RAM path to the resource manager / loaded MOD pointers on Switch, so a mesh cannot change mid-round (RE6 X360 has sResource calls; Switch none).
Screen pickwhip needs a view-projection (camera pos/target/FOV) and a pick_identify backend for Switch MT titles.
donor_swap redraws only RE5 player slots; an enemy class can only go native, no per-carrier redraw.
Sheva Clubbin/Tribal label mapping, which body a costume archive draws, s401-s407 names and the per-round FSM layouts are offline inferences.
Eden boot stall (~2.65 s at the 2nd NVDRV channel; 2 of 9 boots on 11-06, 4 of 9 on 11-09) makes every restart-based swap a gamble without the boot watchdog retry.

ram_maps.title: Resident Evil 5 (Nintendo Switch, v1.0.0, main build EBFFDB223149A725A93CD9B60979F6AA)
notes: MT Framework, 64-bit: every manager is a singleton whose instance pointer sits beside its class descriptor (MtDTI, 0x38 bytes: +8 name, +0x20 parent, +0x30 size>>2, +0x34 id); an object's class is the name its vtable's slot 5 (getDTI) returns.

ASLR moves main every boot: every address is main's base (gbox.mercs.titles.re5_switch.module_base: 64 bytes of main's read-only data at +0x1191000) plus an offset, so this map holds no absolute fields; the driver reads them.

Measured live 2026-10-26 on the Spark (Eden v0.2.1, single-core, NCE: a guest address is the host address) in The Mercenaries United, No Mercy, Public Assembly, Chris (BSAA): sMain base+0x26A1BA8 (sBioMain) +0x584E0 -> cGameSys (+0x944 phase 0/1/3, +0x948 f32 seconds left, +0x94C round time, +0x96C…
The results screen agreed with cGameSys: Enemies Routed 9, Max combo 6x, Score 3,060 (docs/research/re5-switch-ram.md).
Type D controls (the game's default): left stick moves, right stick turns (rleft = larger heading), ZL aims, ZL + ZR fires, L + ZR knife, ZL + B reload.

Live mods (gbox.re5_switch_mods, the playing_ops): the weapon definition records at main+0x1D08680 (0x140 each, +0x1C the Gatling's 'needs no ammo' flag) and the player's time scale (+0x1A08) raised while his shot motion (+0x8F8 = 29) plays: held ZR 2.7 shots/s -> ~25 at x80 (live 2026-10-26).
